title: Summon a Demon and Bind It: A Grounded Theory of LLM Red Teaming
measurement_description: The paper does not explicitly measure or evaluate faith or religion. It only qualitatively documents how red teamers occasionally use religious references metaphorically (e.g., viewing models as deities) or use 'religious symbols' as identity characteristics to probe for biases using Socratic questioning.
findings: The paper contains no direct findings regarding religion. It merely observes that some red teamers use religious metaphors (such as treating the model as a deity) for inspiration when creating prompts, and that referencing 'religious symbols' is one strategy used by practitioners to test models for identity-based biases.
